exposure: Review began after registration lock. Programs/protocol read first; completed output summaries and saved guarded source projection were then inspected. Not blind to scientific result.
checks: Lock hashes match actual files. Receipt allow arguments equal the locked179-selector list, with correct original source and page selector. No forbidden page in saved projection.
All saved readers are exactly ZL3b/IT2a/RF1b. Source IDs unique. Every saved line has consistent row/count/page metadata and all original group indices1..count.
Every exact standalone qoky is represented exactly once. Source list order is used as frozen row/index order; no substring inclusion.

Independent prefix slicing and ASCII ordinal checks reproduce every consumer status, earlier reliable producer and uncertain-prefix list. Consumer uncertainty takes precedence over availability; an earlier reliable producer takes precedence over unrelated prefix uncertainty.
No current or future producer is admitted; page/reader state is separate. qoky does not itself create a producer.

The root validator separately queries the original guarded source and compares the entire P projection, not only selected qoky lines. This auditor checked its code/receipt rather than performing a third raw-source query.
Development and other-page decisions remain separately reported. Any reliable missing case contradicts only this exact stipulated page-prior rule.
limits: Complete means complete relative to the locked transcription and allowlist. A wholly absent physical passage or an incorrect transcription is not independently excluded.
Clear seams and lowercase raw spelling are the registered source-reliability convention, not paleographic truth.
Using a second implementation and audit does not establish qoky meaning, shared meanings of the four producers, a latest resolver or semantic independence.
RF/ZL/IT remain alternate readings, not separate manuscripts.
Full consumer lines are represented by their source IDs in CASES and recoverable in the complete SOURCE artifact.
changes_to_primary: None. No root source, output, protocol, registry or route file modified.
